action.mutates: runs `certbot plugins` once, which creates its log /var/log/letsencrypt/letsencrypt.log, its work directory /var/lib/letsencrypt and its empty hook directories /etc/letsencrypt/renewal-hooks/{pre,deploy,post}; writes the plugin list to /run/p8test-le/plugins.txt (/run/p8test-le created 0700)

creates /etc/puppetlabs/puppet/extra_files/ssl (root 0755, the master's directory, hand-built in production) and, as certbot leaves a renewal, /etc/letsencrypt/live/p8test.example.com and /etc/letsencrypt/live/p8test-other.example.org with privkey.pem, cert.pem and chain.pem of p8test text; runs the deploy script once as root

outcomes.outcome: certbot and the chosen DNS provider's plugin are installed and certbot finds the plugin, with the API token in a root-only credentials file
certbot renew runs from root's crontab on the renew days, with a post hook that reloads nginx
after a renewal the hook's nginx reload takes effect

uncovered.why: the class neither installs nor needs nginx on its node, and the reload has nothing to act on there
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: nginx composed with letsencrypt_base on the class's node
uncovered.evidence: letsencrypt_base declares no nginx package or service (manifests/letsencrypt_base.pp); p8lab-puppetserver's baseline has no nginx

outcomes.outcome: the deploy script and its cron are installed with the maintained domains
the deploy script copies a maintained domain's renewed key, certificate and chain into extra_files/ssl, owned by puppet, and leaves other domains alone
obtaining and renewing a certificate through the DNS provider

uncovered.why: needs the DNS provider's API with a real token and a domain it serves
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: an ACME test endpoint and a DNS provider API stand-in in the lab
uncovered.evidence: the fixture's token is p8test-not-a-secret; the lab has no ACME endpoint (status.py --standins: letsencrypt_certificate)

outcomes.outcome: the hetzner and hetzner-cloud plugins (pip), deployment automation off, other cron times

uncovered.why: one set holds one params fixture (digitalocean, automation on, the default times)
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: more than one params fixture per set
uncovered.evidence: phase3.py applies the class once with its single `fixture` (params or defaults)
